when: The cover's topic-weight table — a ranked value column.
signals: a pipe table inside a cover section
notes: Each row is a .priority-topic with its coloured .priority-id chip and a .count-value pill. The third column only exists when the source has one; a two-column source must not get a blank ruled strip. Every cell carries a class so the editor can name it: `.priority-head` on the column headings, `.priority-cell` on the topic cell, `.priority-count` on the value cell (which holds the `.count-value` pill and any qualifier beside it, such as `लगभग`), and `.priority-marks` on the third column.
